response.sql:
WITH film_filtered AS (
  SELECT rating, length, rental_rate, replacement_cost
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
),
per_rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film_filtered
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_length) AS avg_of_avg_lengths,
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios
FROM per_rating_averages;

assumptions.assumption: The final result averages the per-rating averages with equal weight (unweighted mean of the 5 per-rating values), not a film-count-weighted average across all filtered films.
